title: Averages of diagonal Elliott-Halberstam problem twisted by Möbius function with Sobolev and Hölder-Zygmund weights
summary: Recalling that the so-called Elliott-Halberstam conjecture twisted by the Möbius function $μ(n)$ claims that \[ \sum_{q\leq N^θ}\max_{y\leq N}\max_{(a,q)=1}\left|\sum_{\underset{\scriptstyle n\equiv a\,\mod\,q}{n\leq y}}Λ(n)μ\left(N-n\right)-\frac{1}{\varphi\left(q\right)}\sum_{n\leq y}Λ(n)μ\left(N-n\right)\right|\ll\frac{N}{\log\left(N\right)^{A}} \] for every $A>0$, where $0<θ<1$ is fixed, and also recalling that the validity of this conjecture, in combination with the validity of the classical Elliott-Halberstam for suitable $θ$, proves the binary Goldbach conjecture, in this paper we…
